app.name: Mine Viewer
empty.title: Open a model
empty.hint: DXF, GLB, OBJ or STL. You can pick several files. Files never leave the device.
m.hint: Tap a second point to measure the distance
grid.label: Grid {n}
color.title: Layer colour
diag.none: Open a file to see diagnostics
set.keep: Keep copies of files for the Recent list
set.keepHint: Copies are kept in the app's storage on this device.
set.privacy: The app works without internet and sends no data anywhere.
err.binaryDxf: This is a binary DXF. Save it as a text (ASCII) DXF and open it again.
err.utf16Dxf: The file is UTF-16 encoded. Save the DXF as UTF-8 or ANSI.
err.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported format. DXF, GLB, OBJ or STL is required.
err.glbCompressed: GLB with Draco or Meshopt compression is not supported. Export without compression.
err.glbInvalid: The GLB file is damaged or has an unknown version.
err.notDxf: This does not look like a DXF: no section or entity was found.
err.outOfMemory: Out of memory. Close other files or open the model in parts.
err.storedMissing: The copy of this file was not kept. Pick the file again.
err.intake: Files that could not be received: {n}
err.noGeometry: {name}: the file has no geometry. See the Diagnostics tab.
err.webgl: WebGL is not available on this device, so 3D viewing is not possible.
err.contextLost: Graphics were suspended by the system. Restoring…
warn.truncated: The file ends early. What could be read is shown.
warn.noEof: The file has no EOF marker.
warn.malformedLines: The file has malformed lines; they were skipped.
warn.bulgesIgnored: Arc segments of polylines are drawn straight.
warn.missingBlocks: Some inserts refer to blocks that are not in the file.
warn.badFaces: Some faces refer to vertices that do not exist.
warn.texturesDropped: Textures are not loaded; only geometry is shown.
warn.nonFiniteCoords: Entities with invalid coordinates were skipped.
warn.farOutliers: Some entities are far from the main model (for example near 0,0). Their coordinates are approximate; the view frames the main model.
warn.solidsSkipped: The file has AutoCAD solids or surfaces (3DSOLID, REGION, SURFACE, MESH). They are not drawn: export them as a face wireframe (3DFACE).
